subject: SOC2 evidence: targeted auth log / MFA slices for Oct audit window
messages:
From: Audrey Park <audrey.park@clarityhealth.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@clarityhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SOC2 Type II + auth log slices for Oct audit window

Hi Camila,

We're kicking off our internal audit for Q4 and need to verify a few controls from Redwood's SOC 2 Type II. We have your 2025 SOC2 report, but the auditors asked for: 

- A bridge letter confirming coverage from 2026-01-01 through 2026-10-31 (if available)
- A CSV extract of MFA/auth events for the audit window 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31 (time, user, ip, method, success/fail)
- Evidence of the most recent privileged access review (names, reviewer, date, outcome)

Can you let us know if you can provide those slices and an expected delivery date? Our audit kickoff is next Monday and we'd like to include these artifacts in the package. If anything needs an NDA or secure transfer, please flag it.

Thanks,
Audrey
Security Manager — Clarity Health

(attachment: clarity_audit_request_20261101.pdf)

From: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Audrey Park <audrey.park@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 Type II + auth log slices for Oct audit window

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the requested artifacts. Short plan: 

- SOC2 bridge letter: we have a draft that covers 2026-01-01 through 2026-10-31; Marissa will review for signatures. Target: 2026-11-02 EOD.
- MFA/auth CSV: Vivek's team will extract a time-bound slice with the fields you listed (timestamp, user, source IP, method, outcome). We will deliver via our secure drive link and mark the file as CSV. Target: 2026-11-02 11:00 PST.
- Privileged access review: attach redacted reviewer summary (PII redacted). Target: 2026-11-02 EOD.

If you need a narrower time range or additional fields (e.g., user agent, device fingerprint), let us know now. We'll open a JIRA (JIRA-SEC-412) to track this deliverable and post the Drive link there.

Camila
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

(Notes: will escalate for prioritized extraction; marking as high priority)

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Audrey Park <audrey.park@clarityhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 Type II + auth log slices for Oct audit window

Adding technical details so Audrey and Clarity know what to expect.

We will produce: 
- mfa-auth-log-slice-2026-10.csv (fields: timestamp_utc, user_id, user_email, source_ip, auth_method, auth_result, device_id, user_agent)
- retention: we will include only events that match our production identity domain (redwood.ai) and service accounts used for customer-facing console auths; cross-tenant PII will be redacted.
- audit window: 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z through 2026-10-31T23:59:59Z.
- delivery mechanism: secure Drive folder (link to follow) and an HMAC-signed checksum file.

Two operational notes: 
1) For privileged access review, we'll provide a reviewer summary PDF and a table of elevated roles changed during Q3 (redacted). Full HR PII is omitted.
2) Bridge letter: we have a template; counsel will need to sign off. Marissa, can you confirm signatory for the bridge letter?

I'll start the export job now; expected runtime ~45 minutes.

-- Vivek
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai

(attachment: export_job_log_20261101.txt)

From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Audrey Park <audrey.park@clarityhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 Type II + auth log slices for Oct audit window

Thanks all — confirming next steps from an approvals perspective.

- I will review the bridge-letter-draft.docx and coordinate with legal for signature. We can sign a standard bridge letter confirming SOC 2 coverage for the requested interval; target to get signed copy to Audrey by 2026-11-02 17:00 PST.
- Vivek: prioritize the MFA slice export; if the export includes any customer-specific identifiers outside the scope (rare), flag and we will redact.
- Camila: I'll prepare a short cover note for Clarity's audit package outlining what is included and what is intentionally redacted.

Audrey — if immediate partial delivery helps, we can push the CSV first (sensitive columns redacted), then follow with the privilege review PDF and signed bridge letter. Please confirm acceptance of that cadence.

Marissa
Director, Trust & Safety — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

(attachment: bridge-letter-draft.docx)

From: Audrey Park <audrey.park@clarityhealth.com>
To: camila_reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 Type II + auth log slices for Oct audit window

Camila / Marissa / Vivek — thanks for the quick turnaround and the plan. Partial delivery is fine. Please deliver the MFA/auth CSV first to the secure Drive link (we'll pull it into our audit binder), then the privileged-access summary and the signed bridge letter when available.

Also: we will need an evidence transfer confirmation (simple email) once the files are uploaded. If you prefer to use an encrypted transfer or a Datashare token, let us know; otherwise the Drive link with HMAC checksum is acceptable.

Appreciate it — Audrey
Security Manager — Clarity Health

(asks: please confirm when CSV uploaded; include checksum and any redaction notes)
